subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI ever render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if so under what trust policy?
rationale: Current code, tests, release behavior, and docs intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the request is a UX improvement that changes the security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob image loading unless maintainers approve a proxy, explicit opt-in, or structured media path.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy and tracking tradeoff and require coordinated renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and live browser proof.

options.title: Fold into inline-media policy
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 as the umbrella for accepting or rejecting remote Markdown images with the rest of chat media.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob image loading unless maintainers approve a proxy, explicit opt-in, or structured media path.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI remote image fetch and CSP security boundary, which drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
